input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only liability limitation in the Agreement (p0077, buried in the indemnity section) is one-sided: it caps TrueLink's liability at 12 months' hosting and support compensation while Client's liability, including the broad indemnity in Section 12a, is left entirely uncapped. That is expressly walk-away territory under LOL-CAP (Customer uncapped while Vendor capped), and the sole carve-outs are TrueLink's gross negligence and wilful misconduct — no carve-out for indemnification or confidentiality breaches. The cap is also scoped only to "SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11", which is not an aggregate cap and refers to sections that do not appear in the outline. We therefore fail the fallback on mutuality and carve-outs. The redline targets the fallback: it makes the existing 12-month fee cap mutual and agreement-wide and places indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap. We have not pressed the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential-damages exclusion, data protection/security, fraud and IP carve-outs, or the payment-obligations carve-in, which remain absent and could be raised if negotiation reopens.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
mappings.quote: EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.

mappings.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Make the 12-month fee cap mutual and agreement-wide, and carve out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap of 12 months' fees, so we have made the existing cap apply to both parties across the Agreement rather than to TrueLink alone under selected sections. We have also placed indemnification and confidentiality breaches (alongside gross negligence and wilful misconduct) outside the cap.
